content.rationale: Opening is where S3-new's insert-after-the-newest mechanism meets M-layout's placement and S3-new-position's choice of position and refusal of an ambiguous set; this check runs a real jj in a scratch repo and pins that the opened change lands after the newest named parent with the given summary, that an existing child rebases onto the insertion (no branch), that a forked parent set is a refusal value rather than a panic, and that a bad parent is a failure value.
